question: Does pre-action timing drift recur in identical no-retention execution, and does its timing align with GC or CPU execution state?
basis: retention_order_performance: same-arm signatures/outputs stable but late engine episodes slower before retention acts; no root cause isolated
intervention: Passive per-step GC/CPU observations only; 8 identical none/early release8 episodes in one engine; no cache selector or resource change
workload: Same3 documents P32/P32/P128, outputs16/16/8; inject new request after4 old outputs; release chunk8 only after both old requests complete
reset: Existing drained metadata reset, common warmups, allocations and KV free queue preserved; all runtime layer records retained across episodes
observations: per-step CPU core before/after driver frequency read; driver-exported kHz, not whole-step actual frequency
thread/process CPU and schedstat deltas; overlapping clocks, not summed
RSS and cumulative retained layer-record counts
all request times, row routes, payload/groups, cache and allocation state
accounting: Intersect GC absolute perf-counter envelopes with original engine-call and episode clocks; merge intersections to avoid double counting; report overlap, do not subtract as recovered latency. All observation overhead remains in wall/request times.
retention: All8 plus40 warmup episodes retained, failure stops without retry; previous raw untouched
outcomes: Describe all run/step times, pre-action calls0..3, per-phase GC overlaps, CPU samples and trace equality. If drift unobserved record UNREPRODUCED; do not use this as evidence that previous late arms were fast or that variance is bounded.
stop_conditions: GPU query error/other process abort before initialization; failed execution/identity or causal-action mismatch stop for diagnosis. No outcome-dependent additional runs or threshold scan.
claim_ceiling: Same-program instrumented A/A observation on one model/artificial expert budget; GC/CPU temporal association is not a causal intervention or proof of pure GC/PCIe time. No method GO/noninferiority/population noise floor.
next_if_localized: Only a measured source would justify one cost-complete intervention; no disabling GC and omitting its later collection.
cpu_checks: 4 event tests with timing envelope/unchanged allocation observation check; 2 observer tests; runner 12 argument checks, syntax and git diff --check pass
